content.text:
The tabs now have 12px of padding on the left and right, up from Mantine's default of about 6px at size `xs`. I added one rule to the shared shell CSS in [shell.py](components/alloq-commons/src/alloq_commons/components/shell.py:88):

```css
.aq-segmented .mantine-SegmentedControl-label { padding-inline: 12px; }
```

The team page tabs (Alle / Meine / Aktiv / …) use the same shared `segmented()` control, so this one rule changes them too. It also changes the planning view tabs and the list/card toggle. Lint and the commons tests pass. I haven't looked at it in the browser yet, so reload the page to see the change. If 12px turns out too wide, it's a one-number change.
